_comment: Connection-standard ports for organ-proposal-review. This is a multi-op organ: decide() dispatches on state.kind, and each kind reads a different subset of these inputs and writes a different subset of these outputs. 'inputs' is the UNION of every state key read across all kinds (via state.get(...)); 'outputs' is the UNION of every key written under decide()'s result.output across all kinds. Types map to the vendored ./types.json vocabulary (the canonical orchestrator types.json was 404 — names pending reconciliation, see PR). 'kind' is the only universally-required input (the router discriminator); all other inputs are kind-conditional and null-tolerant (each has a documented fallback in organ.py), hence required=false. NOTE on outputs: the team_review/critique/interviewee_review/synthesis kinds normalize an already-parsed model dict and pass it through, so a real model 'parsed' dict MAY carry additional caller-supplied keys beyond this set; the declared outputs are the canonical keys the organ guarantees (sets via setdefault / always emits), which is exactly the set the committed conformance fixtures pin.
